name: WGSL Shader Branch Audit

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## WGSL Shader Branch Audit Hypothesis

The shared WGPU shader may execute avoidable runtime kind/feature branches in the dominant sprite and quad vertex/fragment paths; a source audit can identify whether pipeline specialization or branch removal has a bounded, behavior-preserving target.

**Attempt Count:** 1.

### Scope Lock

Read-only trace of `shaders.wgsl`, pipeline entry points, primitive-kind dispatch, blend modes, and pipeline construction. No edits.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

Inventory shader entry points and conditional/switch sites, map them to separate pipelines versus shared runtime dispatch, and determine whether any condition is invariant for a hot pipeline. Pass when each candidate is classified with source evidence; fail if evidence requires profiling or backend inspection outside this experiment.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

Select one bounded shader specialization candidate or preserve the shared shader where branches encode real per-instance behavior.

measurements.after: separate pipelines/entry points for quads, shadows, paths, underlines, mono/subpixel/poly sprites, HTML islands, surfaces, post-process variants, visual effects, glow, and screen effects
one two-case switch in fs_mono_sprite distinguishes glyph gamma correction from image-mask raw coverage
measurements.delta: branch represents real per-instance behavior inside texture/order batches; splitting requires new pipelines and potentially more batch/draw boundaries

measurements.after: axis-aligned, unrounded, borderless quads already return before analytic border/SDF work
measurements.delta: remaining branches depend on authored gradient, border, radius, transform, and fragment position

reportMarkdown:
## WGSL Shader Branch Audit Finished

**Passed Status:** true. The renderer already specializes primitive families into separate pipelines and shader entry points. The remaining hot branches encode per-instance authored state or clipping. The mono-sprite glyph/image-mask switch is the only obvious family-kind branch, but those sprites share order- and texture-constrained batches; splitting it would add pipeline/batch state and needs GPU evidence before implementation.

**Attempt Count:** 1.

### Scope Lock

Only WGSL and WGPU pipeline/batch construction were inspected. No production source or adjacent renderer behavior changed.

decisionMarkdown:
### Decision

Preserve current shader dispatch. Do not add shader/pipeline variants without GPU timing that proves the saved branch outweighs extra pipeline and batch transitions. The existing quad fast paths and family-specific pipelines already remove invariant work where the renderer can do so without changing ordering.
